outgoing.name: Capital
outgoing.excerpt: Antanànarìvo (pronounced IPA [æntəˌnænəˈɹiːvoʊ] or [ɑːntəˌnɑːnəˈɹiːvoʊ]), population 1,403,449 ( 2001 census), is the capital of Madagascar, in Antananarivo province.

outgoing.name: Communication
outgoing.excerpt: It is Madagascar's largest city and is its administrative, communications, and economic centre.

outgoing.name: Food
outgoing.excerpt: Industries include food products, cigarettes, and textiles.

outgoing.name: Mosque
outgoing.excerpt: Including an Anglican and a Roman Catholic cathedral, there are about fifty churches in the city and its suburbs, as well as a Muslim mosque.
